systems.name: Octopus Chile
systems.description: Chilean octopus fishery systems map from the Humboldt Current system.

systems.name: Non-urban Water Compliance (NSW, Australia)
systems.description: Systems map of non-urban water compliance in New South Wales, Australia, exploring interactions between regulatory, environmental, economic, and social factors.

systems.name: Salar de Atacama Lithium
systems.description: The Salar de Atacama represents one of Earth's most critical and contested socio-environmental systems, where the global imperative for lithium intersects with extreme ecological fragility, indigenous territorial rights, and complex hydrogeological dynamics.

systems.name: Snowy Water Inquiry Outcomes Implementation Deed (SWIOID)
systems.description: Systems map of the SWIOID system spanning the Upper Murrumbidgee and ACT, exploring interactions between water allocation, hydroelectric generation, environmental flows, and urban water security for Canberra's growing population.

systems.name: Armed Conflict Impacts on Groundwater Resources and Water Security
systems.description: Systems map of armed conflict impacts on groundwater resources and water security (2023–2026), exploring how conflicts in Ukraine, Gaza, the Middle East, and Sudan have created unprecedented cascading water crises.

systems.name: Lake Burley Griffin Water Quality and Cyanobacterial Bloom Management
systems.description: Systems map of Lake Burley Griffin's complex socio-environmental system, exploring how urban development, legacy contamination, invasive species, and climate change interact to drive recurring cyanobacterial blooms threatening recreation, public health, and ecosystem integrity.
